method: Every 7 completed block read at unchanged native marked RGB positions and unmarked NIR context; actual literal pixel/asset/mask/SCL values retained. Finite human-defined visibility exceptions; no threshold/model classifier, source/imagery/raster operation or remote reread.
source_quality: All 236 points in-frame/masks255; validity is not surface truth, and SCL6 at some visually cloudy/fringe positions is not a water decision.

blocks.finding: The west vertical sequence is clear wave-textured water. A short northern arc passes individual cloud/fringe positions retained separately; remaining arc and isolated centres are visible water, including submerged-reef water. No island is established at a centre.

Upper short strip includes two shadow/fringe positions; one southern position is near a small shadow. Remaining strips are visible sea or submerged-reef water. Bright reef and clouds elsewhere are not assigned to centres.
All nine extreme eastern-frame centres are within valid pixels and visibly sea/reef water. There is no inference from adjacent out-of-frame areas.

Upper horseshoe is clear sea; lower small group crosses visible submerged reefs/water, with four cloud-shadow/fringe positions retained. The black eastern region is excluded entirely and contributes no water evidence.

A submerged turquoise reef is blue in NIR. Three interior positions are water over reef; the eastern rim centre remains a fine surf/reef-edge question. Other points are sea; cloudlets elsewhere do not obscure their centres.
The southwest arc is sea, with five individually retained near-cloud/fringe positions. No terrestrial body at a requested centre.

All marked positions are within valid imagery, west of the black eastern margin. Most are visible sea or submerged-reef water. Two northern reef-crest/surf positions remain a fine water-versus-exposure question despite one SCL8 label.
